Subject: Thanks for signing up — next step: pick a 30m dev walkthrough

Hi Alex,

Thanks for signing up for Redwood Inference — welcome!

I wanted to get you set up with a short technical walkthrough so our engineers can see your use case and we can recommend the best model + deployment mode. You can pick a time that works for you here: https://calendly.com/redwood-sdr/30min-dev-walkthrough

A couple quick notes:
- If you prefer an engineer in the call, reply to this email and I’ll add them.
- Please confirm your timezone when you pick a slot (Calendly usually detects it, but good to double-check).

If you want me to propose times directly, say the word and I’ll send 3 options in PST.

Cheers,
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

- Tue 11/28 08:30 PST / 11:30 EST
- Wed 11/29 09:00 PST / 12:00 EST

If one of those works I’ll send the calendar invite and add Soojin. Alternatively, book directly here: https://calendly.com/redwood-sdr/30min-dev-walkthrough (make sure the time zone at the top-right is set to Eastern Time).
